title: Intern Prod Lockout

request.justification: Manager asked me to pull a report from production

expected.explanation: ABAC rule intern-no-prod denies Interns access to production environments regardless of role permissions

teachingPoint: ABAC rules add an extra layer — even if the role matrix had an allow, the ABAC policy blocks interns from prod

title: Cross-Team Bucket Access

request.justification: Need to upload test fixtures for cross-team integration testing

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped requires Developers to only access resources belonging to their own team

teachingPoint: Team scoping is a powerful ABAC control — even valid actions are denied when the resource belongs to another team

title: Own Team Lambda Invoke

request.justification: Testing updated data processing function in dev

expected.explanation: Developer role permits lambda:InvokeFunction in dev, team scope matches, and internal classification is within limits

teachingPoint: When ABAC and RBAC both pass, access is granted — team scope matches and the action is within role permissions

title: Intern Staging Attempt

request.justification: Need staging data samples for my onboarding presentation

expected.explanation: Intern role only permits S3 read in dev environment, not staging

teachingPoint: RBAC catches this before ABAC even applies — interns are dev-only at the role level

title: Cross-Team EC2 Start

request.justification: Payments team is out sick, need to restart their dev instance for a demo

expected.explanation: ABAC rule dev-team-scoped requires team match; core team cannot manage payments team EC2 instances

teachingPoint: Good intentions don't bypass team scoping — each team manages their own resources

title: Developer Own Team Staging S3

request.justification: Reading staging test results for payment flow validation

expected.explanation: Developer role permits S3 read in staging with confidential classification, and team scope matches

teachingPoint: Same team + correct environment + allowed action = access granted through both RBAC and ABAC

title: Security Reads Prod Logs

request.justification: Listing access log files for security review

expected.explanation: Security Engineer role permits S3 read in all environments; no ABAC team-scoping applies to Security Engineers

teachingPoint: Security Engineers aren't team-scoped — they need cross-team visibility for security monitoring

title: Intern Reads Confidential Dev Data

request.justification: Need to read API keys for local development setup

expected.explanation: ABAC rule confidential-no-intern denies Interns access to confidential data even in dev

teachingPoint: Data classification is an ABAC dimension — interns are limited to internal data regardless of environment

title: Developer Snapshots Own DB

request.justification: Creating snapshot before schema migration in dev

expected.explanation: Developer role permits rds:CreateDBSnapshot in dev, team scope matches

teachingPoint: Snapshots before migrations are best practice — and the role matrix supports it in dev

title: Analyst Queries Dev Athena

request.justification: Developing and testing new analytics query in dev environment

expected.explanation: Data Analyst role permits Athena query actions in dev with confidential classification

teachingPoint: Data Analysts have Athena access across all environments — dev is perfect for query development
